sentences.en: We found out their plot before they took their actions.
sentences.zh: 他们在采取行动之前，我们就已经知道了他们的计划。

sentences.en: I think most of them took part in the plot.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们中的大多数都参与了这个阴谋。

sentences.en: The more the plot thickens, the more the mystery unfolds.
sentences.zh: 情节越复杂，谜团就越多揭开。
